title: Entering demo still clobbers a live landlord session; exit still downgrades auth to NotAsked with no session re-check (r2 warning 16 not folded)
evidence: enter_demo: `auth: Success(landlord),` / `csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",` (landlord = demo_store.landlord(store), the mock); clear_demo_state: `auth: NotAsked,` — and neither the BrowserChangedUrl public-route exit (client.gleam:490-497) nor demo_update's UserClickedLogout arm (demo_update.gleam:188-199) dispatches auth_api.check_session afterwards.
detail: An authenticated landlord who navigates to /demo has their real session state replaced by the mock; on exit auth is NotAsked (cookie still valid server-side) so they appear logged out until a full reload.
recommended_fix: On demo exit, dispatch auth_api.check_session(ApiReturnedSession) instead of leaving auth at NotAsked (or stash and restore the pre-demo auth).

title: Stale visibilitychange doc paragraph still sits on handle_browser_change (r2 note 18, third consecutive round)
detail: The paragraph describes listen_visibility_refresh (client.gleam:5905, itself undocumented) but is appended to handle_browser_change's doc block. The r2 rework moved the body again without moving the doc.
recommended_fix: Move the four-line paragraph from handle_browser_change's doc block to listen_visibility_refresh.

title: Unreachable routes.Demo arm still shipped in view_protected_page (r2 note 26 not folded)
evidence:
routes.Demo -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)
    routes.Dashboard -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)  — while view_page (client.gleam:6540-6542) intercepts first: `routes.Demo -> view_demo_page(model)` and is_protected_route maps routes.Demo to False (client.gleam:6624).
detail: view_page handles routes.Demo before the protected fall-through and Demo is not a protected route, so view_protected_page can never receive routes.Demo; the arm is dead code.
recommended_fix: Delete the `routes.Demo -> dashboard.view_dashboard(model)` arm from view_protected_page's content case.

title: demo_store_of/store_of and download_timeout still duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam (r2 note 21 not folded)
evidence: client.gleam: `fn demo_store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore { case model.demo_store { Some(store) -> store None -> case demo_store.seed() { Ok(store) -> store Error(_) -> demo_store.empty_store() } } }`; demo_update.gleam: `fn store_of(model: Model) -> DemoStore { case model.demo_store { Some(store) -> store None -> ... case demo_store.seed() {` — same fallback logic; both files also define their own download_timeout.
detail: Two copies of the same store-fallback helper and timeout helper; the r2 note documented the toast-id drift that this duplication already caused.
recommended_fix: Hoist the store accessor and download_timeout into one demo module imported by both.

title: Demo comparison ids and sweep-nudge dismissals still write to real web storage (r2 note 17 not folded)
evidence: UserToggledComparison arm: `save_comparison_ids(new_ids)` (no demo branch); UserDismissedSweepNudge arm: `save_dismissed_sweep_nudges(set.to_list(updated_dismissed))` (no demo branch); grep confirms demo_update.gleam has no UserToggledComparison/UserDismissedSweepNudge interception, so both fall through to update_inner in demo mode.
detail: Demo-scoped ids persist in web storage and hydrate back on demo re-entry (demo_entry_effects Comparison arm calls load_comparison_ids()) — a refresh-wipe exception, though no real endpoint writes occur.
recommended_fix: Skip the storage writes when model.demo_mode is True, or use a demo-scoped storage key.

title: Demo boot still skips the visibility-refresh listener and localStorage hydrations for the page lifetime (r2 note 30 not folded)
detail: A tab that boots into the demo never installs these listeners; after demo exit + in-SPA signup/login (no reload), the multi-tab policy sync and nudge/explainer hydrations stay missing for the tab's lifetime.
recommended_fix: Install the listeners/hydrations on demo exit (e.g. in the public-route exit branch alongside clear_demo_state).

title: Edit deep-link boot omits vacancy_edit_loading: True — refresh on /vacancies/v-*/edit flashes the empty form for one frame
evidence: enter_demo: `let edit_id = case route { routes.VacancyEdit(id) -> id _ -> model.vacancy_edit_id }` then `vacancy_edit_id: edit_id,` — no vacancy_edit_loading field set (model.gleam:606 initial: `vacancy_edit_loading: False`); view: `case model.vacancy_edit_loading { True -> view_loading_skeleton() False -> ... view_form(model) }`; demo_api.deliver dispatches via effect.from, which runs after the first render.
detail: r2-B4's arm landed (demo_entry_effects VacancyEdit fires get_for_edit) but the recommended vacancy_edit_loading: True did not, so the boot renders the empty edit form for one frame before the response populates it. The in-SPA VacancyEdit arm sets the flag; only the boot path misses it.
recommended_fix: Set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo when the route is VacancyEdit.
